physics_findings: E=mean(E)-grad(phi) with A=-div(sigma grad) and RHS=-div(sigma mean(E)) has the correct sign and enforces div(j)=0. The prescribed harmonic mean field is an external voltage control, with a periodic potential correction.

For a curl-free electric field, div[epsilon(E tensor E-|E|^2 I/2)] = div(epsilon E) E - |E|^2 grad(epsilon)/2. The oracle implements both terms; the completed source retains the second while solving the full current problem. Its physical closure assumes the free-charge force is absent, rather than failing a mathematical current solve.

When sigma=100 epsilon the charge term vanishes exactly. The genuinely two-dimensional calibration still has nonzero projected dielectric-gradient forcing, so reciprocal viscosity is identifiable and the source uses all listed material controls.

The Fourier Leray projection and inverse positive wave-number square solve the incompressible steady Stokes equation with correct force and viscosity signs. The specified uniform mechanical reaction fixes the zero mode for either model; it does no work at zero mean flow.

The reference independently builds conservative finite-volume currents and a pinned potential gauge, then differentiates normal/shear Maxwell stresses onto staggered velocity faces. Its forward-gradient/backward-divergence projection and component-dependent half-cell detector phase are consistent. It does not import the oracle force decomposition.

Fixed Eulerian material profiles, linear isotropic permittivity, electrostriction absorbed into pressure, negligible charge convection/displacement current and excluded extra mechanical material-control forces close the stated reduced continuum model. These are apparatus assumptions, not numerical solver mandates.

findings: The README no longer advertises the calibration profile relation. It supplies the constitutive model, physical controls and velocity readout, without free-charge repair, Maxwell-force decomposition or solution formula.
Public instruction explicitly permits replacing all implementation helpers. Tests constrain API, parameter range, calibration and observable accuracy, without selecting a mathematical method.
Docker copies only public README, model, test and calibration; AUTHOR, hint, oracle and private reference are excluded.
Constant supplied sigma has no output-shaped or parameter-encoding metadata; model starts with viscosity=None. Imports are used in the existing complete electrical and mechanical forward calculation.

The private hidden normalization has RMS floor1e-6 and gate0.04. The validator uses floor1e-8, an inherited minor diagnostic difference; actual local hidden tests are included and passed by the oracle. No tighter grading was introduced.
